title: Notice Shortfall Charging Under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
An approved change of service model on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is asked for on one day and confirmed by the client on another, and the days that run between the two are weighed against the notice the model being left calls for. Where the client confirms sooner than that notice allows, a short notice shortfall stands on the change and is charged for.

The short notice shortfall is the change notice printed against the service model the contract is moving from less the calendar days between the day the approved change of service model was asked for and the day the client confirms, and it is never less than nil.

What the shortfall costs is read off the site's reported headcount, the large site headcount being 400 employees reported for the site.

| The position on the day the client confirms | How the shortfall is counted | What is charged |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A short notice shortfall stands and the site's reported headcount reaches the large site headcount of 400 | In whole weeks, a part week being left uncharged | One fifteenth of the change administration fee the contract carries, rounded to the nearest cent, for each whole week |
| A short notice shortfall stands and the site's reported headcount falls below the large site headcount of 400 | In calendar days | One hundred and fifth of the change administration fee the contract carries, rounded to the nearest cent, for each calendar day |
| No shortfall stands | Nothing is counted | No short notice charge is made |

Points of judgement carried by that basis:

- A reported headcount of exactly 400 reaches the large site headcount and is counted in whole weeks; a reported headcount of 399 falls below it and is counted in calendar days.
- The per week and per day amounts are each struck to the nearest cent as they are struck, and the struck amount is then taken once for every whole week, or once for every calendar day, that the shortfall runs to.
- On the whole weeks counting, a part week at the end of the shortfall is left uncharged.
- Where the calendar days between the day the change was asked for and the day the client confirms reach or pass the change notice printed against the service model the contract is moving from, the shortfall is nil, since it is never less than nil, and no short notice charge is made.

Two hypothetical workings. Take a hypothetical contract whose change notice printed against the service model it is moving from is 45 calendar days, on which the approved change was asked for on 2026-01-05 and the client confirms on 2026-02-01, being 27 calendar days later, so that the shortfall is 18 calendar days; and take the change administration fee the contract carries to be 2100.00 USD. With a hypothetical reported headcount of 900, the shortfall of 18 calendar days is counted as 2 whole weeks with the remaining 4 days left uncharged, one fifteenth of 2100.00 USD struck to the nearest cent is 140.00 USD, and the short notice charge is 280.00 USD. With a hypothetical reported headcount of 260 on the same dates, the shortfall is counted as 18 calendar days, one hundred and fifth of 2100.00 USD struck to the nearest cent is 20.00 USD, and the short notice charge is 360.00 USD.
